title: Active Monitoring of MCJax GKE Workloads
description: Monitor active training job progress by fetching workload run timestamps, querying ML Diagnostics monitored events and analyzer reports on GKE (>= 1.36.0-gke.4447000), and querying runtime logs.

step_notes.query-mldiagnostics-monitored-events: On GKE clusters running version 1.36.0-gke.4447000 and later with hypercomputecluster.googleapis.com enabled, queries automatic machineLearningRun records (<job-name>-<timestamp>) to diagnose silent metric-only PERFORMANCE_DEGRADATION bottlenecks (>= 15% duty cycle drop after the 15-minute duty cycle warmup gate from the last notification time) across 11 subsystems (CPU/Host RAM cgroup saturation, HBM capacity/bandwidth, thermal/power/ICI/ToR throttling, port-9431 PyGrain/Async Checkpointing stalls, and negative hardware rule-out via not_detected_analyzers) plus AutoCaptured XProf .xplane.pb traces (profiler_sessions). For crashes, hangs, restarts, preemptions, or <15m startup/restore stalls, use [[debugging-megascale-hangs]] or [[workload-disruption-orchestration]] instead.
